title: Hazel and the Vow
author: Dominic Pemberton
blurb: Coral Halloran, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
